name: Each solution considered on its own records
principle: Every solution a matter concerns receives its own consideration, against its own records, and no level of the hierarchy is skipped.
state_description: A pass of AI that judges a change for a solution starts from that solution's definition, its recorded results, its selection, the findings queued against it and its connected solutions at the right depth. A parent is judged as its own scope, on how its children combine. Nothing is written per solution: the network forms the prompt.
hints_of_measurement: On cases whose deciding record is held only in the network (a lost result, a finding), the prompt holds it within its budget, and a pass given the prompt reaches the verdict the records support where a pass given the solution's record alone does not.
